options.name: dns_name
options.description: Specifies the DNS name for the certificate.

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: The friendly name of the certificate, used to easily identify the certificate in the certificate store. Default is 'AnsibleCert'.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the certificate.

options.name: store_location
options.description: The target store location for the certificate to be finally imported or checked. Default is the same as `store_location_my`.

options.name: store_location_my
options.description: Specifies the store location for certificate creation. Default is 'Cert:\LocalMachine\My'.

options.name: tmp_file_path
options.description: Temporary file path for exporting the certificate if needed. Default is 'C:\Temp\ExportedCertificate.cer'.

options.name: validity_days
options.description: Defines the validity period of the certificate in days.
